terms.comment: chartāceus, chartācea, chartāceum — made of paper (L&S).

phrases.latin: omnia nostra sarcinae manuālēs sunt, tesserae in tēlephōnō servantur.
phrases.english: all our things are hand luggage, and the tickets are kept on the phone.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
